body:
PXD058121 supplies proteasomal substrate/product time courses, but downstream consumers could not distinguish original input masses, ambiguous sequence assignments, repeated figure views and conflicting publisher quantities. This adds a standalone, source-preserving EvidenceStore package with acquisition/time/organ context and qualified material links.

The pinned 14-asset contract retains all original workbooks, XML cells/formula caches, separate intensity grains and the two documented header/body exceptions. Identity matching never selects by intensity. Missing mass IDs, one publisher disagreement, nine repeated acquisition views, unresolved replicate independence and unknown molar scaling remain explicit. No supervised recipe, physical concentration or predictive performance is claimed.

Validation: format/lint pass; 45 focused source/catalog/package/store/material tests pass. Presto family `2026-10-25_0021_codex_intact-canonical` independently replays 410,349 XML cells (325,718 populated), 44,457 quantities, 17,862 input masses, 8,138 assignments/public context joins and 3,427 publisher links. Source build 13.37 s/659.4 MiB; independent replay 12.25 s/946.7 MiB. The initial verifier omitted substrate-only control labels; its failure and explicit coverage amendment are retained, with canonical bytes unchanged. Full local suite is deferred under the existing 2 GiB disk-headroom policy; full hosted gates remain required.

Version 2.0.33; package schema 26/catalog 32. Source/interpretation spec: `tasks/intact-degradomics-source-spec.md`; public API and limitations: `docs/intact-degradomics.md`.

Addresses #831. Keep that issue open for remaining numeric machinery/material-identity source gaps and later kinetic recipe qualification.
